## Spec

A component writes this trait's fields under `spec.tlsRoute`.

```cue
spec: tlsRoute: #TlsRouteSchema

#TlsRouteSchema: #RouteAttachmentSchema & {
	hostnames?: [...string]
	rules: [#TlsRouteRuleSchema, ...#TlsRouteRuleSchema]
}

// Shared attachment fields for route schemas (gateway, TLS, className).
#RouteAttachmentSchema: {
	gatewayRef?: {
		name!:      string
		namespace?: string
	}
	tls?: {
		mode?: "Terminate" | "Passthrough"
		certificateRef?: {
			name!:      string
			namespace?: string
		}
	}
	...
}

// No L7 match fields for TLS.
#TlsRouteRuleSchema: #RouteRuleBase

// Base fields shared by all route rules.
#RouteRuleBase: {
	backendPort!: uint & >=1 & <=65535
	...
}
```

## Notes

Renders a TLSRoute when the component also attaches the expose trait.
